TrainingRegistration.title: TrainingRegistration
TrainingRegistration.description: Enterprise staff training registration submitted through Google Forms or web intake

staffName.description: Full name of the candidate staff member

staffId.description: Employee ID code, e.g., EMP-4102 or STF-1042

initials.description: 1 to 3 uppercase initials of the staff member

platform.description: Operational platform hub where candidate is based

program.description: Title of the training course requisition

sessionDate.description: Date or schedule interval for the course

remarks.description: Administrative notes or mandatory rejection reasons

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last document update

DataSyncLink.title: DataSyncLink
DataSyncLink.description: Configured external data source link such as Google Sheets published CSV URL or Google Form webhook

title.description: Human readable name of the data source

url.description: Published Google Sheet CSV link or Webhook URL

lastSyncedAt.description: Timestamp of the last sync run

/training_registrations/{registrationId}.description: Real-time master collection of all training requisition submissions and secretary triage decisions

/sync_links/{linkId}.description: Collection of all configured Google Sheet and Google Form data sync links
